floor_history.headline: Recon: honest floor 4 confirmed (candidate applied, HEAD was 9); m2c proves target C shape == our candidate, so the 4-insn gap is two GCC-internal optimizer decisions, not a missing source shape.

Structural: index-off-a0 loop (sibling func_80030900) killed the 3-insn strength-reduce; floor 4->1. Sole residual = idx25 commutative addu operand swap, only closable by a reviewer-FAILED integer-cas

frontier.hypothesis: The idx25 operand swap may have NO non-coercive pure-C form (commutative addu operand order is fixed base-first by pointer_int_sum pre-RA); if a greg/combine RTL dump confirms no legitimate C flips it, this is a 1-insn operand-order-only endgame-lock candidate (cf. endgame-lock-disposition-policy).
frontier.mechanism: front-end pointer arithmetic lowering canonicalizes ptr+int to base-first; only integer-domain offset-first (a cheat) reorders it.
frontier.next_probe: cc1 -da greg/combine RTL dump on the score-1 .i at the s2 add; confirm the plus operand order is set at tree-lowering and no live-range/declaration lever moves it. If confirmed dead, file for endgame-lock disposition (1 insn, operand-order-only, matches only via reviewer-rejected cheat).

frontier.hypothesis: decomp-permuter re-seeded from the score-1 base may find a non-manual structural lever for the last insn that the pointer-spelling sweep missed.
frontier.mechanism: randomized/directed structural search from the closer base explores forms outside the hand-derived pointer-vs-integer axis.
frontier.next_probe: Build a clean single-function target.o (offset 0 via asm/funcs + prelude.inc) and run decomp-permuter from the score-1 candidate.c with --stop-on-zero under fresh-seed discipline; harvest in-turn; vet any closing form against the cheat catalog (the int-cast form is already known-rejected).

frontier.hypothesis: A deeper struct-typing restructure where the index is naturally the pointer base could yield index-first legitimately.
frontier.mechanism: if the original modelled a0 such that the s1-scaled value is the pointer operand and a0 the offset in a semantically-honest way, GCC would lower index-first without a coercion cast.
frontier.next_probe: Reconstruct the likely original struct/array typing at 0x330/0x332 (count + u16 slot array) and see whether a faithful `&arr[s1]`-style expression off a differently-typed base emits index-first without an integer cast; measure + re-review.
